definition: Oriol Vinyals (born 1983) is a Spanish machine learning researcher.
details: He has developed most of his career at DeepMind. He is a co-founder of Discovery Loop, and was technical lead on Gemini until August 2026, along with Jeff Dean.

explainer.lead: Oriol Vinyals is a Spanish machine learning researcher.

contributions.name: Vinyals co-invented the seq2seq model for machine translation along with Ilya Sutskever and Quoc Viet Le.
He led the AlphaStar research group at DeepMind, which applies artificial intelligence to computer games such as StarCraft II.

timeline.what: He then moved to the US and studied for a Master's degree in computer science at University of California, San Diego, and at University of California, Berkeley, where he received his PhD in 2013 under Nelson Morgan in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences.
His research in DeepMind is regularly featured in the mainstream media As of August 2024, he was technical lead on Gemini, along with Noam Shazeer and Jeff Dean.
